# Generated by Omen Build System
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(GemSample CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Module: AppModule
add_library(AppModule SHARED
    Source/App/Private/Main.cpp
)

target_include_directories(AppModule PUBLIC
    Source/App
)

# Module: Greeter.Static
add_library(Greeter.Static SHARED
    Gems/Greeter/Code/Source/Static/Private/Greeter.cpp
)

target_include_directories(Greeter.Static PUBLIC
    Gems/Greeter/Code/Source/Static
)
target_compile_definitions(Greeter.Static
    PRIVATE O3DE_GEM_NAME=Greeter
    PRIVATE O3DE_GEM_VERSION=1.0.0
)

# Module: Greeter.Runtime
add_library(Greeter.Runtime SHARED
    Gems/Greeter/Code/Source/Runtime/Private/GreeterRuntime.cpp
)

target_include_directories(Greeter.Runtime PUBLIC
    Gems/Greeter/Code/Source/Runtime
)
target_compile_definitions(Greeter.Runtime
    PRIVATE GREETER_RUNTIME_EXPORTS
    PRIVATE O3DE_GEM_NAME=Greeter
    PRIVATE O3DE_GEM_VERSION=1.0.0
)

# Main executable
add_executable(GemSample_exe
    # Add your main.cpp here
)

target_link_libraries(GemSample_exe PRIVATE
    AppModule
    Greeter.Static
    Greeter.Runtime
)

set_target_properties(GemSample_exe PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "GemSample")
